normalization_rules.reason: llvm-objdump prints the preferred alias 'mov' for MOVZ/MOVN wide-immediate moves when representable as a synthesized immediate, whereas MachGraph prints the underlying 'movz'/'movn' mnemonic (scheduled for M2).
llvm-objdump prints 'udf' for permanently-undefined A64 words (0x0000_0000..0x0000_ffff), whereas MachGraph emits raw '.inst' directives for undefined encodings (scheduled for M2).

Apple's llvm-objdump Mach-O printer appends Neon arrangement specifiers to the mnemonic (e.g. 'fmov.2d', 'cmeq.16b'), whereas MachGraph places arrangement suffixes on the vector register operands ('fmov v0.2d, ...'). Conditional branches ('b.eq', 'b.ne', ...) are kept intact because the condition is part of the branch mnemonic.
